step.cmd: In FTS, determine if a revised registration number exists:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 2.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised(M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the appropriate BPC.
Work item: Select 92 - Purge and Recreate .
Work type: Select 22 - Change to special benefits counter .
Remarks line 1: Type “ADC update, CT 3 start in w/c [XXXX] to [XXXX], LDW [XXXX], RCV WK [XXXX].”
Remarks line 2: Type “CT 4, EDC [XXXX], ADC [XXXX], Ext MSW [XXXX], NO-CR-CODE (if applicable).”
Remarks line 3: Type “CT [14 for standard parental benefits or 16 for extended parental benefits], APW [XXXX], PSW [XXXX], ENT WKS [XX], SEX [XX], NO-CR-CODE (if applicable).”
Remarks line 4: Enter claimant’s report information.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts- entitlement review .
Infraction: Select C - Non-fraud - Insurability - new information .
Message: Select 27 - An overpayment resulted due to an incorrect calculation .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and change the registration flag as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: In ACS, create and send the N-00-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Special benefits approved (3046) and select the appropriate options based on the type of special benefits being paid on the claim.
Special benefits denied (3065) .

Sickness benefits denied - D2/D16/D22/D33/Free text (3066) .
Select D33 - Not otherwise available .
Select Indefinite/Definite/Multiple Disentitlement dates (2485) and select the appropriate option.
Text - Reasons why not otherwise available (1630): Type the details.
Select If sickness after maternity (4418) .
Right to Request Reconsideration (with Blank option) (4169): Select Right to request a Reconsideration .
